text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants are required: more than 17 years old, high school graduate or above, physical and mental health, non-Chinese citizens holding foreign ordinary passports, and their status should be in accordance with the provisions of the Ministry of Education’s Education and Foreign Affairs Letter [2020] No. 12. 2. Applicants under the age of 18 are required to provide a letter of guarantee from their guardian. If the applicant’s parents are not in China, the applicant's parents need to appoint a foreigner or a Chinese person who usually resides in China as the guardian.
